articles.title: US Army fields new system for sweeping munitions planning, management
articles.summary: The service expects this first increment of TACTMIS to replace the previously used TAMIS system once it retires on Oct. 30.

articles.title: 86th IBCT (MTN) Relinquishes Command of JMTG-U
articles.summary: The Joint Multinational Training Group-Ukraine held a colors casing ceremony at the 7th Army Training Command headquarters on Oct. 15, 2026. Task Force Luzon, composed of the 86th Infantry Brigade Combat Team (Mountain) from the Vermont National Guard, cased its colors, relinquishing command responsibility for the mission.

articles.title: Passing the colors: Inigo gives final salute to 103rd Troop Command Soldiers
articles.summary: Col. Phoebe P. Inigo relinquished command of the 103rd Troop Command to Col. Byron Cadiz during a ceremony presided over by Brig. Gen. Ronald D. Hogsten, commander of the Hawaii Army National Guard. Inigo’s 22 months in command included responses to natural disasters, federal mobilizations and training with international partners.

articles.title: JMSDF Fleet Submarine Force Commander visits CTF-74
articles.summary: YOKOSUKA, Japan — Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF) Vice Adm. Noaya Hoshi, commander, Fleet Submarine Force, met with U.S. Navy Rear Adm. Gary Montalvo Jr., commander, Submarine Group 7 (CSG 7)/Task Force 74 (CTF 74) at Commander, Fleet Activities Yokosuka on Oct. 13, 2026.

articles.title: Connecticut National Guard hosts welcome home ceremony for 1-102nd Infantry
articles.summary: The Connecticut National Guard hosted a welcome home ceremony and Yellow Ribbon reintegration event for 1st Battalion, 102nd Infantry at the Gov. William A. O’Neill armory Oct. 17, 2026.

articles.title: Forging Agile Leaders: 192nd Wing officers sharpen leadership skills during inaugural exercise
articles.summary: On October 17, 2026, junior officers from the Virginia Air National Guard's 192nd Wing participated in an inaugural development exercise at Joint Base Langley-Eustis to strengthen their leadership and decision making skills for Agile Combat Employment operations.

articles.title: Voices of the VaANG: Master Sgt. Sabrina Jahner and Tech. Sgt. Stephen Kolmer, Leader Empowerment and Development program instructors
articles.summary: Master Sgt. Sabrina Jahner and Tech. Sgt. Stephen Kolmer have been selected as the new instructors to spearhead the Virginia Air National Guard's reignited Leader Empowerment and Development program.

articles.title: Multi-state RED HORSE units fortify Pacific airfields, advance Agile Combat Employment
articles.summary: Civil engineers from the Virginia Air National Guard’s 203rd RED HORSE completed a historic deployment across Guam, Japan and Tinian, partnering with Florida Air National Guard and active-duty units under the 513th Expeditionary RED HORSE banner.

articles.title: Kansas honors 130th Field Artillery Brigade with homecoming from Operation Epic Fury
articles.summary: The Kansas Army National Guard's 130th Field Artillery Brigade was recognized at a Yellow Ribbon reintegration event after a deployment that shifted from the deterrence-focused Operation Spartan Shield to the combat operations of Operation Epic Fury.

articles.title: Colonel Retires After 27 Years of Making His Mark on History – And Having Fun
articles.summary: Col. Tim Newman of Fisher, Ill., retired from the Illinois Army National Guard after 27 years of “standing the watch.” Family, friends and fellow service members celebrated nearly three decades in uniform during an Oct. 10 retirement ceremony at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Library.

articles.title: US arms firm Anduril could make interceptors in Europe, executive says
articles.summary: U.S. defense firm Anduril could eventually manufacture its newly unveiled Steelfin interceptor missiles in Europe, a company executive said.

articles.title: Six Soldier-athletes to represent Army WCAP at United World Wrestling Championships in Kazakhstan
articles.summary: Six Soldier-athletes from the U.S. Army World Class Athlete Program will carry Army pride and medal ambitions on to wrestling’s biggest international stage.

articles.title: A final flight, a new chapter: 944th Operations Group welcomes new commander
articles.summary: An F-16 Fighting Falcon from Holloman Air Force Base stood alongside an F-35 Lightning II inside Hangar 999 at Luke Air Force Base, Ariz.

articles.title: Pentagon’s wireless services left locations, data exposed, watchdog finds
articles.summary: Security vulnerabilities meant that malicious groups could “pinpoint sensitive locations like safe houses or command posts, and expose operational vulnerabilities, significantly compromising national security.” The post Pentagon’s wireless services left locations, data exposed, watchdog finds appeared first on Task & Purpose .

articles.title: Maine National Guard, Coast Guard strengthen search and rescue partnership through joint training
articles.summary: The Maine National Guard and U.S. Coast Guard conducted a joint search and rescue training exercise Oct. 7, simulating a search for a missing kayaker at Acadia National Park to strengthen coordination between the two organizations and improve emergency response capabilities.
